name: Group Feint (Ex)
category: Drop Dead Studios – Advanced Rogue Talents
body:
Prerequisites: Advanced Rogue Talents, Feint Expert

Benefit: The rogue’s quick movements and distracting motions can throw an entire group of enemies off balance. As a full- round action, a rogue with this talent may make a separate feint check against every enemy she threatens.
